tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Ask Briarwood Detox Center admissions to call the person about medically supervised drug or alcohol detox in Austin, Houston or San Antonio, Texas. Admissions is answered 24 hours a day. Do not include health details, insurance identifiers or date of birth; admissions will ask the person directly.

phone.description: A US phone number admissions should call.

best_time.description: Best time to call, in the person's own words. Optional.

note.description: Anything the person wants admissions to know before calling, up to 500 characters. No health details.

tools.name: request_insurance_verification
tools.description: Start a free insurance benefit check for detox at Briarwood. Sends only name, phone, email and the carrier name; admissions calls the person for the member ID and date of birth, or the person completes it at https://www.briarwooddetox.com/verify-insurance/. Never send the member ID, group number or date of birth through this tool.

phone.description: A US phone number admissions should call.

insurance_carrier.description: The insurance company name, e.g. Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, UnitedHealthcare, Cigna. Optional.
